standing_dt_comparison.result: Production 0.010 s with two 0.005 s PhysX steps agrees materially with the 0.005 s reference across qualified standing loads.

squat_dt_comparison.alignment: Align traces at first DESCENT command; the fixed 50-tick setup window causes the absolute timestamp offset.
squat_dt_comparison.result: After command alignment, event times agree within 15 ms and bar paths within 2.252 mm.

position_iteration_oracle_convergence.oracle_metric: relative torque error; max absolute torque error
position_iteration_oracle_convergence.result: Lower iteration counts approach the 255-position-iteration oracle result monotonically in mean relative and maximum absolute error; the production arm has zero gated errors.

2.reason: The override also sets the barbell velocity iterations to 2; the production configuration assertion expects 6.

4.reason: The override also sets the barbell velocity iterations to 4; the production configuration assertion expects 6.

velocity_iteration_sensitivity.interpretation: Measured B12 physical outputs at loads 0-140 kg vary negligibly. The sweep XMLs remain recorded as failed configuration assertions; neither threshold nor production configuration was changed.

coarse_dt_characterisation.result: The 0.020 s step is materially worse in the reported 300 kg characterization case.

limitations: The 2- and 4-velocity-iteration sweep executions have configuration-check failures because the shared test override also changes the bar solver. Their recorded physical metric comparison is usable for sensitivity characterization, but those invocations are not claimed as passing suites.
The squat reference uses a fixed 50-tick setup window; compare event times and paths after descent-command alignment.
